## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:access` · `pm:queue`. The tab bar asks the sidebar's one navigation guard

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-01T08:59Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

**Why p2.** The mobile tab bar draws entries that the sidebar hides for visibility or a missing permission, and an action entry becomes a dead link. The navigation surfaces disagree. The routes behind those entries still answer for themselves, so nothing is exposed.

**Direction.**
- `MobileBottomNav` filters through the same shared guard the sidebar, area derivation and Favorites use (`passesNavItemGuards`). ⛔ No second guard.
- An `action` entry is dropped from the tab bar unless it can be rendered as the sidebar's action button.
- **Serial:** PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11359 (the href half) edits the same component. Whichever lands second merges.
- **Pins:** the card's table, with a visible, permitted entry as the control.

- No other `pm:dispatched` claim names these files.

Ruling: triage `5928170094`, verbatim where it binds: "`MobileBottomNav` filters through the same shared guard the sidebar, area derivation and Favorites use (`passesNavItemGuards`). ⛔ No second guard." "An `action` entry is dropped from the tab bar unless it can be rendered as the sidebar's action button." "**Pins:** the card's table, with a visible, permitted entry as the control."
Scope: the PR says `Fixes #11362`.
`Clause-②: no`. Why: the tab bar draws fewer entries, the ones the sidebar already hides. No accept set, export or prop widens. If the guard has to become a new export, the dev says so, and the seat re-judges this line.

## ACCEPT: PR objectui#11393 (`Fixes #11362`), head `2a1af96de2`

`domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01JG2jy8a9su7ia4Hx7zxv42` · 2026-10-01T17:21Z. Claim `5935963982`, dev report on this card. Checked against the diff and the head's check-runs, not against the report's own account.

| item | reading |
|:--|:--|
| shape | Draft, base `main`. The first line is `Fixes #11362` and the second is `Clause-②: no`. No other closing keyword appears in the body. 3 files, +254 / −9. NOT GOVERNED |
| the ruling (`5928170094`) | `MobileBottomNav`'s `collectLeaves` asks `hasVisibleNavigationItems([item], guards)` of each node before anything else. That is the sidebar's per-node answer: `passesNavItemGuards`, then a group only through a visible child, and an `action` only when `onAction` is wired. `guards` is the same object the area derivation reads (`navGuards`, built from the sidebar's own inputs), so there is no second guard. The guard runs before the five-tab slice. An `action` entry draws as a button handing the item to `onAction`, and is dropped when none is wired, as the sidebar does |
| `Clause-②: no`, confirmed | `passesNavItemGuards` was deliberately NOT exported (`packages/layout/src/index.ts` re-exports `NavigationRenderer` wholesale); the already-exported `hasVisibleNavigationItems` carries it. `MobileBottomNav` is module-internal, and `AppSchemaRendererProps` is unchanged |
| changeset prose (seat, sentence by sentence, under the maintainer's ruling in objectstack-ai/objectstack#21187) | `.changeset/11362-mobile-tab-bar-nav-guard.md`: `@object-ui/layout` patch. Every sentence is true of the diff, including "the guard runs before the cap" and "a group the viewer may not see takes its entries with it" |
| tests | red at base `8673402`: 6 failed, 1 passed (the control passed). Green at the fix: 14 passed. Three ablations, each with its predicted direction: guard deleted (5 red), action branch off (1 red), guard after the slice (2 red). Each restore is proven by blob equality. Final head after merging `main`: 54 files, 1247 tests |
| CI | head `2a1af96de2`: 43 check-runs. 40 `success`, including `Lint`, `Type Check`, all eight `Test` shards and `Spec Main Shape Gate`. 3 expected skips: `Test (coverage)`, its unexpanded matrix placeholder, and `dependabot`. 0 failure. Mergeable `clean` |

**Out-of-scope findings, one line each:**
- Tab **order**: the bar keeps authored order while the sidebar sorts by `order`, so above five entries the cap keeps the wrong five. This is class (a), measured through the real `AppSchemaRenderer`. It is the third member of the "tab bar answers differently from the sidebar" family (objectui#11211 href, objectui#11362 entry set). Fixing it needs the sidebar's sort shared rather than copied, so it is not done in place. → this seat files the family's closure card next.
- `nav-menu-renderer.tsx` writes the guard sequence out by hand. It agrees today, with no producer of a divergence → Acceptance notes.

**Landing.** Next: `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` through the fleet relay. On MERGED, the seat verifies the change by content, closes the card with a close note if `Fixes` leaves it open, and strips `pm:dispatched`.
